_about: The price list and what each plan includes. Data only: the owner's final pricing replaces this file, no code changes. Checked by parseCatalogue() in shared/src/billing.ts and tests/billing-catalogue.test.ts. Amounts are per full seat per month; 'year' is what a month costs when paid for a year. A cap of null means no limit. Mirror every price in Paddle (one price per plan and interval, with a country override per regional price below).

trial._source: owner, 17 Nov (request form, his approval, 3 months; seats asked for, auto-approvable up to 25)

dunning._source: assumption: Paddle retries a failed renewal for about 30 days before it cancels; we keep everything open for that long, then read-only

tax.name: Sales tax / VAT
tax._source: Paddle (merchant of record) works out and adds the buyer's tax at checkout; rate depends on the buyer's country or state

regions._note: No TRY list yet (owner decision): Paddle converts the USD list at checkout. Paddle collects TRY but does not pay out in TRY (research-gtm / business plan 4.1).

tax.name: KDV
tax._source: assumption: 20% VAT on digital services added for consumers; a business accounts for it itself (reverse charge)

regions._note: Draft from business plan 4.3 (48% of the USD list at 89 INR/USD, unverified FX). Monthly by default: India's e-mandate limit (15,000 INR per automatic renewal) asks the buyer again above it.

tax.name: GST
tax._source: business plan [G2]: Paddle adds 18% GST for consumers only

regions._note: Draft from business plan 4.3 (parity, 1.30 SGD/USD unverified FX).

tax.name: GST
tax._source: business plan [G2]: Paddle adds 9% GST for consumers only

regions._note: Collected in USD (73% of the list) until Paddle's MYR support is confirmed; MYR shown as a guide (4.20 MYR/USD unverified). Switch: set collect to MYR and prices to displayPrices.

tax.name: SST
tax._source: business plan [G2]: Paddle adds 8% SST to businesses too

regions._note: Paddle cannot collect AED, SAR or QAR (business plan 4.1, R3 PD4 verified): the Gulf pays the USD list. AED is shown as a guide only.

tax.name: VAT
tax._source: assumption: 5% UAE VAT added for consumers; a VAT-registered business reverse-charges
